note: A transposed broadcast-batched projection carries its batch axis only in the strided operand. The contiguous reduction operand must become contraction A so the tensor-core schedule can bind. On an NVIDIA A100 80GB, deployable-O3 strict W5/I20 repeats measured 17.588-19.784 us versus torch.compile at 10.854-11.894 us: a material improvement, not parity.
